p: of babes and sucklings hast thou: Though the wicked would hide God's praises, yet the very babes are sufficient witnesses of the same.
man: It was sufficient for him to have set forth his glory by the heavens, though he had not come so low as to man who is but dust.
sheep and oxen: By the temporal gifts of man's creation, he is led to consider the benefits which he has by his regeneration through Christ.
